subtopic: Searching EDGAR and Identifying Form Types
source_evidence: Filings with “/A” appended to the form type code indicate an amendment.
question: Misconception: A filing labeled 10-K/A is a different form type from 10-K, such as a quarterly report.
answer: A 10-K/A is an amendment to a 10-K filing. The “/A” suffix indicates an amendment; it does not mean the filing is a different report type.
